title: Terence McKenna's overdosing girlfriend sees an energy UFO full of mantids

tellings.quote: she sees up above and behind Terrence McKenna a huge uh UFO made of energy.

plain: Writer Jason Jorjani tells Jesse Michels a story about Terence McKenna, a well known speaker on psychedelic drugs. According to Jorjani, a girlfriend of McKenna's, while overdosing, saw above and behind him a huge UFO made of energy, filled with insect-like beings resembling praying mantises, which he offers as a link between altered states and contact with non-human beings.
